linkedin par jald hi russia mein pratibandh lagaya ja sakta hai 27 october 2016 rtcom linkedin vyaktigat data par russia ke sanghiya kanoon ka pahla shikar ban sakta hai. duniya ke sabse bade peshevar netvark ne apne server russia mein sthanantrit nahi kiye. facebook netvark kanoon samaj peshevron ke liye netvarking site linkedin duniya ka sabse bada vyavasay aur rozgar unmukh social netvark hai. sroteephpi/eest news duniya ka sabse bada propheshnal netvark linkedin jald hi russia mein blok ho sakta hai. company us kanoon ka palan karne mein viphal rahi hai jo companies ko desh mein russian upyogkartaon par data rakhne ke liye badhy karta hai. tass samachar agency ke saath ek sakshatkar mein roskomnadzor ke prawakta vadim empelonski ne kaha hum linkedin ko blok karne ke liye adalat ke aadesh ki mang kar rahe hain. humne garmiyon mein do baar anurodh bheje lekin unhone humare sawalon ke jawab nahi diye. russian internet vochdog roskomnadzor ke anusar server ko russia mein na le jane ke alawa linkedin un logon ke bare mein jankari ekatr karta hai aur bhejta hai jo unki sahmati ke bina netvark ke upyogkarta nahi hain. yakutiya woh jagah hai jahan google ko data sangrahit karna chahiye prawakta ke anusar moscow ke taiganski zila nyayalay ne nigrani sanstha ke paksh mein faisla sunaya hai lekin linkedin ne uchch nyayalay mein apil ki hai. "agar apiliya adalat faisle ko barkarar rakhti hai aur ab iske khilaf apil nahi ki jayegi to nirnay 30 dinon ke bhitar lagu ho jayega. hum vyaktigat data adhikaron ke ullanghnakartaon ke rajistar mein uchit aaeepi pata shamil karenge jiska arth hai avruddh karna "empelonski ne kaha. faisla 10 november ko sunaya jayega agar social netvark yeh jankari pradan karta hai ki usne kanoon ka palan kiya hai aur russians ke bare mein data wale server ko desh mein sthanantrit kar diya hai to nigranikarta pratibandh hata dega. prawakta ne kaha yeh pahli company hai jis par hum adalat mein muqadma kar rahe hain. bhavishya mein hum anya companies ke sambandh mein bhi isi tantra ka upyog karenge. roskomnadzor ne komarsent dainik ko yeh bhi bataya ki muqadme ka ek anya karan social netvark se upyogkarta data ke baar-baar lik hone ke bare mein media mein kai prakashan the. bada bhai sun raha hai sawdhan mai mein website hakerru ne 167 million churae gaye linkedin khaton aur dark web par 117 million khaton ke password ki bikri ki soochna di. linkedin ne kaha ki lik 2012 mein hua tha aur password ab update kar diye gaye hain. linkedin duniya ka sabse bada vyavasay aur rozgar unmukh social netvark hai. 2015 tak iske 400 million upyogkarta the aur 5 million log russia mein panjikrit the. sabse pehle rtcom dwara prakashit.

"mainne kuch bhi swikar nahi kiya. unke wakeel matthew mari ne kaha ki unke muvakkil ne apni begunahi barkarar rakhi hai. unhone kaha woh is baat par adi hui thi ki usne qubool nahi kiya hai aur woh doshi nahi hai. police ne sushri ko bhavnatmak roop se pareshan bataya lekin shri mari ne kaha ki woh unke medical itihas se anjan the aur unhone unke kisi bhi rishtedar se baat nahi ki thi. shri mari ne kaha usne mujhse kaha ki uska kisi prakar ka chikitsiya itihas raha hai lekin woh isme nahi jayegi. unhone kaha ki unhone mangalwar ko sushri ki upasthiti se pehle unke saath lagbhag 15 minat bitae aur woh shant thin lekin bahut batooni nahi thin. unhone kaha uske paas kahne ke alawa aur kuch nahi tha boli woh doshi nahi hai. "aur woh kisi aur cheez par charcha nahi karna chahti thi. unhone kaha sushri par koi aapradhik doshsiddhi nahi hai aur woh teen saal se kvins mein usi pate par rah rahi hain. unhone kaha lagbhag do ya teen saptah pehle tak woh gharelu sahayika ke roop mein kam karti thi lekin unhone yeh nahi bataya ki woh ab niyojit kyon nahi hai. nyaymoorti lebovits ne chunaw ke din nichli adalat mein upasthit hokar zila atorni ke anurodh ko swikar kar liya ki sushri ko bina jamanat ke hirasat mein rakha jaye. unhone uski agli peshi guruwar ke liye tay ki. sushri votan ya sushri ka koi bhi rishtedar adalat mein nahi tha. estoriya kvins mein sushri votan ke apartment bhawan mein pariwar ke ek mitra ne kaha ki unke pati robert baat nahi karna chahte the.

yaun utpidan ke aaropon ke bare mein vistar se likha hai jiske parinamswaroop july mein unhe fox news ke adhyaksh pad se hata diya gaya tha. shukrawar ko new york ne shri sherman dwara shri ails aur unke patan ke bare mein ek lamba lekh prakashit kiya aur july mein shri sherman ne sabse pehle report di ki roopart murdoch aur unke beton lachlan aur james ne shri ails ko hatane ka faisla kiya hai. pahlavan halk hogan jinka asli naam teri ji boliya hai ke paksh mein $140 million ka faisla jita. woh mamla mistar hardar ke liye ek peshevar brekaaut tha jo pehle mashhoor hastiyon ke liye adhik niymit adhikar pravartan mamlon ko sambhalne aur aamtaur par niptane ke liye jane jate the. muqadme ke baad silikon vaili ke arbapti udyami peter thiel ne khulasa kiya ki unhone shri boliya ke muqadme aur gokar ke khilaf anya kanooni mamlon ko gupt roop se vittaposhit kiya tha. shri hardar da deli mel ke prakashak ke khilaf pichle saptah dayar manhani ke muqadme mein republican rashtrapati pad ke ummidvar donald je trump ki patni melania trump ka bhi pratinidhitv kar rahe hain. shri hardar dwara da deli mel politico aur liberal america sahit kai prakashnon ko patra bheje jane ke turant baad muqadma dayar kiya gaya tha jisme un lekhon ko wapas nahi lene par kanooni karwai ki dhamki di gayi thi jinmen sushri trump ne manhanikarak bayan diye the jisme yeh bhi shamil tha ki woh ek baar eskort thin. muqadma dayar hone ke baad deli mel ne lekh wapas le liya aur maafi jari ki.

jaise ki yooralmaish ke vishal faiktari hall. maikenikal engineering company kabhi soviyat udyog ki pramukh company thi. aaj yeh kalakaron aur rachnatmak logon ke liye el doraido hai. adhik denis tarasov ko dekhne ke liye niche scroll karein 1960 ke dashak ke ant se 1990 ke dashak tak ek nishchit gennedi vlasov ne yooralmaish mein kam kiya. vlasov ka janm 1943 mein sevradlovsk mein hua tha - jo aaj yooral kshetra ki rajdhani yekaterinbarg hai. denis tarasov 1961 mein unhone yooralmaish commercial school se snatak kiya aur ek maikenikal engineer ke roop mein kam par rakha gaya. unki zimmedari ka kshetra aantrik corporate sanchar tha unhone deewar samachar patra likhe nare design kiye aur soochnatmak-vyangyatmak poster banaye. denis tarasov 1980 ke dashak mein unhone karyabal ke rozmarra ke audyogik jivan ko roshan karne ke liye ek naye praroop ki khoj ki unhone phaiktri hall mein tool lokar par prasiddh russian kalakaron dwara laindaskep penting ko phir se banana shuru kiya. denis tarasov ne jin prasiddh kritiyon ki nakal ki unme udahran ke liye garl vid e kairiing yok aur arkadi plastov ki he harvest shamil thin. soviyat kalakar ne gramin jivan ke rozmarra ke drishyon ko samajvadi yatharthavad ki shaili mein chitrit kiya. saath hi vlasov ne apni rachnaen bhi design kin. denis tarasov kuch bindu par yooralmaish karyakartaon ne tool box ke liye vishisht roopanknon ko chunna shuru kar diya. ye zyadatar prakritik paridrishy the - audyogikran ke antim charan mein kala ek karkhane ki dhoosar rozmarra ki zindagi se bachne ka ek tareeka tha. denis tarasov aaj tak suramy paridrishy vishal mashinon ke vishal samrajy ke madhyam se taazi hawa ke jhonke ki tarah pratit hote hain jo maun ke liye abhishapt hain. denis tarasov kuch saal pehle inme se kuch chhaviyan internet par dikhai din aur gailri malikon ke ek samooh ka dhyan aakarshit kiya. samkalin kala premiyon ne vlasov ke lokron ko ek pariyojna mein badal diya tha jise unhone yekaterinbarg mein ek dvivarshik ke hisse ke roop mein prastut kiya tha. denis tarasov tool lokar is baat ka udahran hain ki kaise rozmarra ki vastuen manchit hone ke baad kala ban sakti hain. denis tarasov hum yahan varshon se the aur chitron se thak gaye the yooralmaish ke poorv karmachari hanste hain jab ve ek samooh ko vlasov pradarshani ka daura karte dekhte hain. denis tarasov halanki pradarshani thodi atishyokti hai is tathya ke alawa ki kyooretar kala samikshak aur patrakar aate hain faiktari hall mein kuch bhi nahi badla hai. facebook

pittsburgh simphani orchestra ne thanksgiving ke thik samay par budhwar ko hadtal ka niptara kiya. hadtal ka samadhan tab hua jab iske sangitkaron ne apni paribhashit labh pension ko rokne par sahmati vyakt ki aur prabandhan ne shuruaati 75 pratishat vetan katauti par samjhauta kiya jo ki uski mang ka aadha tha. anubandh jise budhwar ko anumodit kiya gaya tha orchestra ke liye marg prashast karta hai - ek pramukh samooh jo is garmi mein europe ke pratishthit salzabarg aur lyoosarn utsavon mein pradarshan karne wala hai - agle saptah kam par lautne ke lie. orchestra muft mein da myoozik haiz ritarnd! ki jodi bajaega. 2 aur 4 december ko apne sangit nirdeshak mainafred honek ke saath sangit karyakram. 30 september ko pittsburgh hadtal ne shastriya sangit jagat ko sadme mein dal diya. texas mein chhota fort varth simphani orchestra us mahine ki shuruaat mein hadtal par chala gaya tha aur kam se bahar hai aur 30 september ko prasiddh philadelphia orchestra ne hadtal shuru ki jo 48 ghante tak chali jisse simphani orchestra ke bare mein naye sawal khade ho gaye. unki chunautiyon ko apnana. pittsburgh ke prabandhan ne chetavni di ki orchestra ke paas nakdi khatm ho rahi hai sangitkaron ki pension rokne pehle varsh mein unke vetan mein 15 pratishat ki katauti karne aur asthayi roop se kalakaron ki tukdi ke aakar ko kam karne ka aahvan kiya gaya. sangh ne ek paribhashit labh pension yojna se ek paribhashit yogdan yojna ki or badhne ke liye khulapan vyakt kiya basharte ki sabse pratikool roop se prabhavit logon ki madad karne ke prawadhan ho - lekin ve bade vetan katauti par ade hue the. ve hadtal par chale gaye naye anubandh mein pehle varsh mein 75 pratishat ki katauti ki baat kahi gayi hai jiske bare mein orchestra ne kaha ki yeh 105 pratishat hoti agar koi agyat dankarta isme shamil nahi hota. anubandh mein khiladiyon ko unke vartaman aadhar vetan par bahal karne ki baat kahi gayi hai - lagbhag $107000 - panchven varsh men. orchestra ne ek nayi paribhashit yogdan sevanivritti yojna swikar ki aur prabandhan un sangitkaron ko atirikt yogdan dene par sahmat hua jinhe sabse adhik nuqsan hoga. aur samooh jisme vartaman mein 99 sangitkaron aur do laibreriyan ka poorak hai us aakar ko banaye rakhega lekin teen rikt padon ko khali rakhega. pittsburgh simphani orchestra samiti ke adhyaksh mika hovard ne kaha ye dardanak aur paryapt riyayten thin. "humne paya hai ki pata lagaye gaye signal bilkul pichle prakashan mein bhavishyavani kiye gaye [alaukik buddhimatta] signal ke aakar ke hain aur isliye is parikalpana ke anuroop hain. tathya yeh hai ki ve keval soory ke varnakramiya prakar ke nikat kendrit ek sankirn varnakramiya sima ke bhitar taron ke ek bahut chhote hisse mein pae jate hain yeh bhi ekstraterestriyal intelligence parikalpana ke anuroop hai "shodhkartaon eeeph borra aur ee trotiyar ne apne paper mein likha hai. shodhkartaon ne yeh bhi not kiya ki unke dwara samne rakhi gayi parikalpana ki pushti ya khandan karne ke liye aur kam karne ki awashyakta hogi. aisa karne ke liye vibhinn upkarnon par saman sanketon ko dekhne ki awashyakta hogi jisse anya sabhi spashtikranon ko tyagne mein sahayta milegi. yeh kary ek tathakthit swatantra sanstha dwara kiya jayega.

barlin eephpi - germany ki sarkar ne budhwar ko sambhawit roop se khatranak mane jane wale charmapanthiyon par nazar rakhne ke liye takhne ke kangan ke upyog ko manjoori de di kyunki yeh barlin truck hamle ke baad sandigdh jihadiyon par sakht hone ke liye kadam utha rahi hai. [prastawit upay sanghiya aapradhik police ko kisi apradh ke liye doshi thahrae jane se pehle hi suraksha ke liye khatra samjhe jane wale vyakti ki gatividhiyon ko electronic roop se track karne ki anumti dega. kaibinet dwara is upay ki anumti dene ke liye kanoon mein badlaw par sahmati ke baad aantrik mantri thomas di mejiere ne kaha takhne ke kangan ramban nahi hain lekin ve khatranak logon ki nigrani ki suwidha ke liye ek mahatvapurna upkaran hain. prastaw ko abhi bhi sansad se manjoori milni baki hai yeh 19 december ke hamle ke jawab mein ghoshit suraksha sudharon ki ek shrrinkhla ke hisse ke roop mein aata hai jisme tyoonishiyai nagrik anis amri ne barlin ke bhid bhare christmas bazaar mein ek truck ghusa diya tha jisme 12 log mare gaye the. hamle ki zimmedari charmapanthi islamik state samooh ne li thi jiske kai dinon baad milan mein italian police ne aamri ko goli mar di thi. yeh samne aane ke baad ki aamri pehle se hi khufiya sevaon ke radar par tha aur use islami kattarpanthiyon se sambandh rakhne ke liye jana jata tha janta ka gussa turant bhadak utha. ek asafal sharan chahne wale ke roop mein use hamle se mahinon pehle nirwasit kiya jana chahiye tha lekin tyoonishiya samay par awashyak kagazi karwai bhejne mein viphal raha. german sarkar ne tab se nirwasan mein tezi lane ki kasam khai hai aur aswikrit sharan chahne valon ko unke nishkasan se pehle hirasat mein rakhne ki yojna banai hai jinhe khatra mana jata hai. german suraksha sevaon ke paas sarvajnik suraksha ke liye khatra mane jane wale 550 se adhik islamvadiyon ki soochi hai jo germany mein rahte hain ya vartaman mein rahte hain. aantrik mantralay ke prawakta johans dimroth ne yeh anuman lagane se inkar kar diya ki ab kitne sandigdhon ko electronic nigrani ka samna karna pad sakta hai. unhone barlin mein sanvaddataon se kaha bhavishya mein unme se kitne log is tarah ke upay se prabhavit ho sakte hain yeh poori tarah se kalpanik prashn hai.
